scope: Shared cockpit backboard, quadrant, padding and exposed-metal finishes across all 53 aircraft.
method: Original deterministic procedural PNGs; periodic noise, directional alloy grain and retained upholstery recipes. Metric UVs, near-white tintable basecolor, tangent normal and glTF G-roughness/B-metalness data. Images shared within each model and embedded for portability.
finishSelection: Explicit per-aircraft material names and panel recipe; authored variant colors retained. Appearance approximation, not verified coating specifications.
changes: Four primary surface recipes: stippled enamel, satin coating, rubberized grain and brushed alloy. Existing paint, vinyl, canvas and webbing retained.
Finish after cabin batching and physical control completion; no textures on displays or printed legends.
Legacy airliner cabin batch separated from exterior details; Cessna 172 material matching survives material cloning.
Gallery supports panel-finish filtering and extra P-51/Baron quadrant and MiG-29 backboard views.

checks: Asset import and inspect --verify for all 53 models
Source/runtime embedded PNG equality, finish confinement, UV tangent area and image bounds
Biome checks on changed authoring modules
validation.reproduction: Run each source/aircraft/<slug>/models/generate.mjs --out <candidate.glb>; compare SHA-256 to current master.

renderReview.findings: Subtle grain reads on panels and quadrant housings; gauges remain clear. Metal hardware has a restrained directional sheen. Exterior material confinement is verified structurally and reviewed in representative turntables.
renderReview.contactSheets: All 53 cockpit overview renders inspected across four contact sheets, plus listed close-up and exterior views.
